cyberbullying = bullying that happens on the internet or by phone
equal = having the same rights and chances as others
unfair = not right or not treating people the same
help out = to give practical help
raise money = to collect money for a purpose
public transport = buses, trains and trams that anyone can use
traffic = cars and other vehicles on the road
pedestrian = a person walking in the street, not in a vehicle
rules = instructions that say what you may or may not do
polite = having good manners; not rude
rude = not polite; speaking or acting in an unkind way
respect = a feeling that someone is valuable; to treat them that way
generation = all the people of about the same age in society
responsibility = a duty to deal with something or take care of it
behave = to act in a particular way, especially well or badly
good manners = polite ways of speaking and acting
police station = the building where police officers work
arrest = when the police take someone away because of a crime
prison = a building where criminals are kept as punishment
thief = a person who steals
